findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed window is the score-time interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities are removed and an equal score prior is used, so no absolute affinity label is observed and last-record credit cannot be read as final affinity benefit.

Continuous contrast features over the observed support are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dx shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts; a constant rule is therefore not supported over the whole window and any time-conditioned rule must be restricted to observed-node interpolation.

Several local coordinate contrasts have large opposing first and last rate z-scores (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z strongly negative and last_rate_z positive; landmark_00_local_cyy similar), indicating rate turnover within the window rather than a stable signed direction.

No polynomial fit is accepted for these continuous features (polynomial_accepted false) and extrapolation is disallowed, so the observed-node linear representation is the only validated contrast description and no out-of-window extrapolation is licensed.

hypotheses.falsifier: If a constant regional weight matches observed-node contrast as well as the time-conditioned rule within the reported node RMSE, the time-conditioning is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx contrast values at observed score nodes
hypotheses.scope: observed window [0.0,0.5], observed score nodes only
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention recipe that follows the validated observed-node contrast sign (rather than a constant static regional weight) would better match the observed non-monotone landmark contrast over the window.

hypotheses.falsifier: If a single signed rate reproduces both early and late observed-node slopes within the reported node RMSE, turnover is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: first_rate_z and last_rate_z of landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_cyy
hypotheses.statement: The large opposing first/last rate z-scores for local coordinate contrasts reflect within-window rate turnover that a single signed coordinate reward direction cannot represent.

limitations: Recorded affinities are removed and an equal score prior is used, so no absolute affinity or final-affinity benefit can be claimed from these observations.

Only continuous_trends rows for landmark_00 features were read; other tables (survival, increment, turnover, joint, regional, endpoint) were not inspected in this turn, so selection enrichment versus absolute geometric descriptors and descendant survival credit remain unassessed.
No decoded terminal labels are available, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The supplied evidence does not permit a multiplicity-adjusted ranking decision differing from point estimates within the rows read.
No registered reward recipe was executed; the hypotheses are descriptive and their expression in a permitted recipe is not established here.
